```{r}
# LACHS Methodology

# Varun's article
# https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC8887645/

# Weight Variables:
# POP_WGT - Represents the sampling weights, their sum is close to 8million
# which is reasonable value for adult population of LA county in 2018.
# POP_SAMWGT - Represents the scaled population weight, it has a mean of 1, 
# values range from 0.1 to 9.53
# /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
```

# 2018
```{r}
# Load data
# merged places comes from places.R script
# Used .rds to preserve geometry column. Saving as .csv removes the <sf> object functionality
data_2018 <- readRDS("D:\\rwjf_noise\\data\\prepped_data\\merged_lachs_2018.rds") 

data <- data_2018

# data %>%
#   pull(PHQ) %>%
#   table()

# Modify PHQ, Depression, Asthma, and General Health to set the Don't know and refused to NA
# otherwise they will form small groups that may pose problems for model sparsenes
data <- data %>%
  mutate(across(c(PHQ, ASTHMA, DEPNOW, HSGEN, HSPH, HSMH, HSALD), ~ ifelse(.x %in% c("Do not know", "Refused"), NA, .x)))

# Collapse Age group
data <- data %>%
  mutate(AGEGROUP_c = 
    case_match(
      AGEGROUP,
      c("18-24", "25-29", "30-39") ~ "18-39",
      c("40-49", "50-59") ~ "40-59",
      .default = "60+")
    )

# Set Refused to NA for GENDERO
data <- data %>%
  mutate(GENDER = ifelse(GENDER == "Refused", NA, GENDER)) 

# Collapse race
data <- data %>%
  mutate(RACESOP_c = 
    case_match(
      RACESOP,
      c("AI/AN", "Do not know", "Multiracial/Other", "NHOPI", "Refused") ~ "Other/Unknown",
      .default = RACESOP)
    ) %>%
  mutate(RACESOP_c = factor(RACESOP_c, levels = c("White", "African American", "Asian", "Latino", "Other/Unknown")))

# Convert to numeric
data <- data %>%
  mutate(across(HSPH:HSALD, ~ as.numeric(.x)))


```

# Unweighted Respondent characteristics
```{r}
data %>%
  mutate(has_geoid = ifelse(is.na(GEO_CT), 0, 1)) %>%
  select(
    AGEGROUP_c, RACESOP_c, GENDER, FPL_FIN,
    PHQ, DEPNOW, ASTHMA, HSGEN, HSPH, HSMH, HSALD,
    has_geoid) %>%
  mutate(across(HSPH:HSALD, ~ as.numeric(.x))) %>%
  tbl_summary(
    # by = has_geoid,
    statistic = list(
      all_continuous() ~ "{mean} ({sd})",
      c(HSPH, HSMH, HSALD) ~ "{median} ({p25}, {p75})"
      ),
    label = list(
    AGEGROUP_c ~ "Age",
    RACESOP_c ~ "Race", 
    GENDER ~ "Gender",
    FPL_FIN ~ "Federal Poverty Line",
    PHQ ~ "Positive for PHQ2", 
    DEPNOW ~ "Current Depression", 
    ASTHMA ~ "Asthma", 
    HSGEN ~ "Self-reported General Health", 
    HSPH ~ "Number of Poor Physical Health Days in the Past 30 Days", 
    HSMH ~ "Number of Poor Mental Health Days in the Past 30 Days",
    HSALD ~ "Number of Activity-limited Days in the Past 30 Days",
    has_geoid ~ "GEOID Available"
    )
  ) %>%
  bold_labels()
```

## Weighted Respondent Characteristics
```{r}
# Create a survey design object to display weighted respondent characteristics
des <- svydesign(
    ids = ~1, # Sets sampling units or post stratification units
    weights = ~POP_WGT, # Sets populations weights
    data = data
)
```

```{r}
des %>%
  tbl_svysummary(
    include = c(AGEGROUP_c, RACESOP_c, GENDER, FPL_FIN,
    PHQ, DEPNOW, ASTHMA, HSGEN, HSPH, HSMH, HSALD),
    statistic = list(
      all_continuous() ~ "{mean} ({sd})",
      c(HSPH, HSMH, HSALD) ~ "{median} ({p25}, {p75})"
      ),
    label = list(
    AGEGROUP_c ~ "Age",
    RACESOP_c ~ "Race", 
    GENDER ~ "Gender",
    FPL_FIN ~ "Federal Poverty Line",
    PHQ ~ "Positive for PHQ2", 
    DEPNOW ~ "Current Depression", 
    ASTHMA ~ "Asthma", 
    HSGEN ~ "Self-reported General Health", 
    HSPH ~ "Number of Poor Physical Health Days in the Past 30 Days", 
    HSMH ~ "Number of Poor Mental Health Days in the Past 30 Days",
    HSALD ~ "Number of Activity-limited Days in the Past 30 Days"
    )
  ) %>%
  bold_labels() 
```

# Number of responses per tract (denominator = all unique geocoded tracts)
```{r}
data %>%
  drop_na(GEO_CT) %>%
  group_by(GEOID) %>%
  count() %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(n) %>%
  mutate(n = factor(n)) %>%
  tbl_summary(
    label = list(n ~ "Number of responses per tract")
  )
```


# Frequencies & proportions of outcomes with geocoded data
```{r}
data %>%
  mutate(has_geoid = ifelse(is.na(GEO_CT), 0, 1)) %>%
  mutate(
    has_phq = ifelse(has_geoid ==1 & !is.na(PHQ_num), 1, 0),
    has_dep = ifelse(has_geoid ==1 & !is.na(DEPNOW_num), 1, 0),
    has_asm= ifelse(has_geoid ==1 & !is.na(ASTHMA_num), 1, 0),
    has_gen= ifelse(has_geoid ==1 & !is.na(HSGEN), 1, 0),
    has_phd= ifelse(has_geoid ==1 & !is.na(HSGEN), 1, 0),
    has_mhd= ifelse(has_geoid ==1 & !is.na(HSGEN), 1, 0),
  ) %>%
  select(has_phq:has_mhd) %>%
  tbl_summary(
    digits = all_categorical() ~ c(0, 2)
  )
```

# Comparisons of 2018 to 2023 Helicopter Noise

```{r}
data <- 
  bind_rows(
    data_2018 %>%
      select(pw_exp_db, pw_exp_lin, GEOID) %>%
      distinct() %>%
      mutate(year = "2018"),
    data_2023 %>%
      select(pw_exp_db, pw_exp_lin, GEOID) %>%
      distinct() %>%
      mutate(year = "2023")
  )
```

```{r}
data %>%
  ggplot(aes(y = pw_exp_lin, x = year)) +
  geom_boxplot()
```

```{r}
# Average out in linear then convert to dB
data %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(mean_noise = mean(pw_exp_lin, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(mean_noise = 10 * log10(mean_noise))
```


```{r}
# decibels
broom.mixed::tidy(
  lmerTest::lmer(pw_exp_db ~ year + (1 | GEOID), data = data)
)
```

```{r}
# sound energy levels (linear)
broom.mixed::tidy(
  lmerTest::lmer(pw_exp_lin ~ year + (1 | GEOID), data = data)
)
```


```{r}
# Change in dB if using the linear values in the model
# Suggests 2023 is much quieter
-1 * (10 * log10(19528))
```
